meta.author:
Top Worship 新店行道會音樂
詞曲：鄭曼綺、宗睿哲、吳思葦

lines.b: Though in the wilderness
I'm overwhelmed in weakness
I will bow on my knees
It is your will I'll be seeking
Lord lead me closer to you
No matter ups or downs
You'll be renewing my strength
Fire pour down on me
Raise all the ashes up again
A fire blazing in me
Lord would You come

lines.a: 點燃我們起初為祢 火熱的心
lines.b: Ignite the first love in our hearts that burns for You

lines.a: 主祢打開天門 焚燒煉淨我們
lines.b: You open the heavens, You purify Your Church
Oh Lord we wanna know Your heart
Lord would You come

lines.a: 興起我的生命成為 馨香的活祭
lines.b: Revive our lives to be Your pleasing sacrifice

lines.a: 主祢彰顯大能 醫治釋放我們
lines.b: You move with Your powers, bring healing and freedom

lines.a: 求祢再次降臨 點燃我的心
lines.b: Lord would You come again, come ignite my heart

lines.a: 聖靈如風吹起挑旺信心
lines.b: Holy Spirit come and stir up my faith

lines.a: 呼召因祢烈火再次燃起
lines.b: Every calling from You burning again

lines.a: 奔向祭壇全然獻上自己
lines.b: I will give my whole life on the alter
Holy Spirit come
Lord would You come
